title: hermeneutic: an evidence-first drift gate that mines AI chat-log corrections to gate the next response
description: hermeneutic is an evidence-first drift gate that catches AI response drift before it ships by mining chat logs for the corrections a user already made, classifying the drift, and running those patterns as a three-stage pre-flight gate on outgoing drafts (zero-LLM regex, then optional hermes-rubric scoring, then a bring-your-own-calibration LLM critic called PressureProbe). It targets silent failure modes that aggregate evals and observability miss; cheap stages run first so most drafts never reach an LLM call. The shipped regex patterns are derived from 326 corrections mined across 1,423 sessions, documented in evals/triple-mining-receipts.md; the private session triples themselves are not shipped.
